rows.grounds: adverbial phrase indicating sounded execution; fused sa + śabdaṃ
compound of pāda, hṛd, masta, pradeśa in locative plural

items.question: In what order and with what sound should the practitioner strike foot, heart, and head places?
premises: ritual striking occurs in ordered bodily places
items.inference: The verse prescribes sounded, sequential contact at foot, heart, and head.
uncertainties: exact ritual action and mantra context are not specified in this short verse
items.plain_english: With sound, in the places of foot, heart, and head, in order.
